items.title_en: I went to the world’s deepest rave and getting there was more terrifying than you’d think
items.title_zh: 我去了世界上最深的狂欢节，到达那里比你想象的更可怕
items.summary_en: You're best off forgetting everything you know about conventional raving before heading to Roni Size's latest underground set. Overthought outfits, guzzling pre-drinks and heading home in a taxi at an ungodly hour were all out of the question, as this rave took place 1,375 feet below the surface of a mountainous region in North Wales . Donning helmets and harnesses, a small group made a treacherous two-hour descent to experience Size's exclusive subterranean set at Cwmorthin Slate Mine last week - and it was an…
items.summary_zh: 在前往 Roni Size 最新的地下音乐场所之前，您最好忘记所有关于传统狂欢的知识。考虑过多的服装、大量的酒前饮料以及在不合时宜的时间乘出租车回家都是不可能的，因为这场狂欢是在北威尔士山区地表以下 1,375 英尺的地方举行的。一小群人戴上头盔和安全带，历经两个小时的危险下降，体验了 Size 在 Cwmorthin 的独特地下场景

items.title_en: Dead goats are being dumped in a forest and no one knows why

items.summary_en: A notice attached to a railing detailing the grisly discovery in a Somerset woodland (Picture: Cover Images) The dumping of dead goats in a forest in Somerset has left the landowner utterly perplexed. Four carcasses were found at a quarry in woodland between Wiveliscombe and Fitzhead village last month. Local residents and the farmer who owns the land were surprised to learn about the gruesome discovery in an official notice attached to railing at the top of a steep drop down through the woodland. Heart of the…
items.summary_zh: 栏杆上贴着一张告示，详细介绍了萨默塞特林地中可怕的发现（图片：封面图片）萨默塞特森林中倾倒死山羊的事件让土地所有者完全困惑。上个月，在威维利斯科姆和菲茨黑德村之间林地的一个采石场发现了四具尸体。当地居民和拥有这片土地的农民惊讶地发现，在陡峭的悬崖顶部栏杆上附有一份官方通知，发现了这一可怕的发现。

Most people have heard of Valhalla, the Norse afterlife where Vikings feasted, drank, and fought to the death only to rise again each day. But there was another realm for the dead that isn’t as well-known: Helheim. items.summary_en: Kelly Graf Archaeologists excavating Shég’ Xdaltth’i’ found more than 80,000 relics that demonstrate how ancestral Native Americans lived some 13,000 years ago. Archaeologists excavating a prehistoric site in Alaska known as Shég’ Xdaltth’i’ discovered a wealth of remains from a 13,000-year-old base camp built by some of the first ancestral Native Americans to settle the continent. The site was near the Bering Land Bridge, a stretch of terrain connecting Asia and North America that formed 35,000 years ago, but has…

items.title_en: From The Real-Life ‘Conjuring’ To A Satanic Nun, Explore 9 Horrifying Tales Of Demonic Possession

items.summary_en: There are some things in the world — bumps in the night, shadows in the corner of the eye — that seem to escape explanation. But the people in the stories below insist that the strange events they experienced were nothing short of demonic possession. Some, like Latoya Ammons, had multiple witnesses — nurses, priests, and even police — to back up their stories. Others enlisted the help of paranormal investigators like Ed and Lorraine Warren, who also swear that the strange events in question actually happened.
